senses.definition: To speak of someone or something in a way that quietly lowers how others see it.
distractors: To make something already said finally make sense by laying the reasoning out in order.
To back a claim with evidence that somebody else is able to check for themselves.
To turn an object in memory into bytes that can be stored or sent.
To avoid something deliberately and on principle.
To rely on someone to carry part of the weight.
